sections.label: Taxi surge pricing position
sections.summary: The Minister was asked about the Ministry's position on taxi surge pricing, preventing overcharging, and giving passengers prior information.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Transport (a) what is the Ministry's position on the practice of taxi operators adopting surge pricing during off-peak hours to reflect market demand; (b) what can it do to prevent overcharging; and (c) how can passengers be given prior information on when the taxi companies are imposing the surge pricing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: They felt they had to make this move in order to compete against private hire car services like Uber and Grab.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The PTC was conscious that some commuters are uncomfortable but, on balance, allowed it.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We should not prevent the taxi industry from adapting to meet stiffer competition.

sections.label: Metered fares and dynamic pricing notice
sections.summary: Metered fares remain an option, and taxi companies must give commuters at least one week's notice before starting dynamic pricing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Metered fares will remain an option for commuters booking a taxi ride, if they are not so comfortable with dynamic pricing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The taxi companies are required under the law to give commuters sufficient notice, at least one week, before commencing dynamic pricing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Grab had announced on 22 March their plans to implement dynamic pricing, which happened on 29 March, and ComfortDelGro had announced their plans on 17 March.

sections.label: Ambulance for critical emergencies
sections.summary: For critical situations an ambulance is advised, while street hails and app bookings on metered fares remain available for non-critical emergencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: If it is really a critical situation, my advice would be to call an ambulance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: That is the best way to get to treatment fastest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: But if it is not a critical emergency, then traditional options like street hails, bookings via apps on a metered fare basis still available.
